newsitem.title: USA: China built missile plant in Pakistan - report.
newsitem.headline: China built missile plant in Pakistan - report.

text.p: The White House and State Department have ignored a CIA report that China helped Pakistan construct a factory to manufacture medium-range ballistic missiles, Time magazine reported on Sunday.

The magazine said U.S. intelligence services discovered the facility near Rawalpindi in late 1995 and concluded that China was not only selling missiles to Pakistan but also helping the Pakistanis build a factory to manufacture them.
If confirmed, such a report could endanger the Clinton administration's policy of extending Most Favored Nation trading status to China, due to be discussed this week in Congress.
China had promised in 1994 not to sell such sensitive military technology to other nations.

By late last summer, the CIA concluded that China had delivered to Pakistan not just missile parts but also 30 ready-to-launch M-11 missiles, each capable of carrying a 1,100-pound (500 kg) warhead more than 185 miles (297 kilometres).
The Pakistanis were working to produce nuclear warheads to fit on top of the missiles, the magazine said.
By last October, the CIA and other agencies agreed on a "statement of fact" that warned the White House and State Department of its conclusions, the magazine said.
But the Clinton administration, anxious not to endanger relations with China, refused to scheduled inter-agency meetings on the report or discuss whether China should be penalized, the report said.
